Container.Name: Stoat-Chat
Container.Overview:
Stoat (formerly Revolt) is a self-hosted, open-source chat platform - a privacy-focused alternative to Discord.
⚠️ IMPORTANT: This template configures a DOCKER COMPOSE application with multiple containers.
📋 DEPLOYMENT OPTIONS: Choose between two deployment modes: • 🌐 PUBLIC DOMAIN: Accessible from internet with your domain • 🔐 TAILSCALE: Private network access via Tailscale VPN
📋 INSTALLATION STEPS: 1. Install "Docker Compose Manager" from Community Apps 2. Configure this template with your preferred settings 3. The setup will automatically: - Create the docker-compose.yml file - Generate secure credentials - Configure environment files - Set up data directories
✨ FEATURES: • Real-time messaging with WebSocket support • File uploads and attachments • Image and link previews • GIF search via Tenor • Push notifications • Full API access • Multi-server deployment ready
📋 REQUIREMENTS: • For PUBLIC: Domain name with DNS pointing to your server • For TAILSCALE: Tailscale account and auth key • 2GB+ RAM recommended • Docker Compose Manager plugin
🔧 CONFIGURATION: This template provides comprehensive configuration options: • Deployment mode (Public Domain or Tailscale) • Data storage paths • Port configuration • Security settings • Advanced features (invite-only, GIF search, etc.)
📖 Full documentation: https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/stoat-unraid
Container.Requires:
Docker Compose Manager plugin is REQUIRED for this multi-container application. Install from Community Apps before proceeding.
This template will create a complete docker-compose.yml setup in your appdata directory.

Config.Name: Deployment Mode
Config.Description: Choose deployment mode: 'domain' for public access or 'tailscale' for private VPN access

Config.Name: Domain/Hostname
Config.Description: For PUBLIC: Your domain (e.g., chat.example.com). For TAILSCALE: Your Tailscale hostname (e.g., stoat.tail1234.ts.net). DNS must point to this server for public domains.

Config.Name: Appdata Path
Config.Description: Main directory for Stoat configuration, compose files, and service data. All Stoat data will be stored here.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for web access. For Tailscale mode, this can be any available port since it won't be publicly exposed.

Config.Name: HTTPS Port
Config.Description: HTTPS port for secure web access. For Tailscale mode, this can be any available port since it won't be publicly exposed.

Config.Name: Tailscale Auth Key
Config.Description: TAILSCALE ONLY: Your Tailscale auth key (starts with tskey-auth-). Get this from Tailscale Admin Console → Settings → Keys. Leave empty for public domain mode.

Config.Name: Tailscale Hostname
Config.Description: TAILSCALE ONLY: Hostname for your Stoat instance on Tailscale network (will become hostname.tailnet.ts.net)

Config.Name: Invite Only Mode
Config.Description: Enable invite-only registration. When true, users need an invite code to register.

Config.Name: RabbitMQ Username
Config.Description: Username for RabbitMQ message broker. Change for better security.

Config.Name: RabbitMQ Password
Config.Description: Password for RabbitMQ message broker. Will be auto-generated if left empty.

Config.Name: MinIO Username
Config.Description: Username for MinIO S3-compatible storage. Change for better security.

Config.Name: MinIO Password
Config.Description: Password for MinIO S3-compatible storage. Will be auto-generated if left empty.

Config.Name: Database Data Path
Config.Description: Path to store MongoDB database files

Config.Name: Files Storage Path
Config.Description: Path to store uploaded files and attachments

Config.Name: Redis Data Path
Config.Description: Path to store Redis cache data

Config.Name: RabbitMQ Data Path
Config.Description: Path to store RabbitMQ message queue data

Config.Name: Tenor API Key
Config.Description: Optional: Tenor API key for GIF search functionality. Get from https://developers.google.com/tenor/

Config.Name: Enable Push Notifications
Config.Description: Enable push notifications (requires additional FCM/APM configuration)

Config.Name: Behind Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Set to true if Stoat is behind another reverse proxy (SWAG, NPM, Traefik, etc.)

Config.Name: VAPID Private Key
Config.Description: Auto-generated: VAPID private key for push notifications. Leave empty to auto-generate.

Config.Name: VAPID Public Key
Config.Description: Auto-generated: VAPID public key for push notifications. Leave empty to auto-generate.

Config.Name: Files Encryption Key
Config.Description: Auto-generated: Encryption key for file storage. Leave empty to auto-generate.

Container.PostArgs:
# Stoat Chat - Post Installation Setup echo "===================================" echo "🚀 STOAT CHAT - SETUP STARTING" echo "==================================="
# Create directory structure mkdir -p "${APPDATA_PATH}/data/database" mkdir -p "${APPDATA_PATH}/data/files" mkdir -p "${APPDATA_PATH}/data/redis" mkdir -p "${APPDATA_PATH}/data/rabbitmq" mkdir -p "${APPDATA_PATH}/config"
# Download setup script and compose files cd "${APPDATA_PATH}"
# Check if repo already exists, if not clone it if [ ! -f "setup-unraid.sh" ]; then echo "📦 Downloading Stoat Unraid files..." git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/stoat-unraid.git temp-repo cp -r temp-repo/* . rm -rf temp-repo chmod +x setup-unraid.sh fi
# Generate secure passwords if not provided if [ -z "${RABBITMQ_PASS}" ]; then export RABBITMQ_PASS=$(openssl rand -hex 16) fi if [ -z "${MINIO_PASS}" ]; then export MINIO_PASS=$(openssl rand -hex 16) fi
# Build setup command based on deployment mode SETUP_ARGS="${STOAT_DOMAIN}" if [ "${DEPLOYMENT_MODE}" = "tailscale" ]; then SETUP_ARGS="${SETUP_ARGS} --tailscale" fi if [ "${BEHIND_PROXY}" = "true" ]; then SETUP_ARGS="${SETUP_ARGS} --behind-proxy" fi if [ "${HTTP_PORT}" != "80" ]; then SETUP_ARGS="${SETUP_ARGS} --http-port ${HTTP_PORT}" fi if [ "${HTTPS_PORT}" != "443" ]; then SETUP_ARGS="${SETUP_ARGS} --https-port ${HTTPS_PORT}" fi
# Run setup script echo "🔧 Running Stoat setup..." ./setup-unraid.sh ${SETUP_ARGS}
# Configure Tailscale auth key if provided if [ "${DEPLOYMENT_MODE}" = "tailscale" ] && [ -n "${TAILSCALE_AUTH_KEY}" ]; then echo "🔐 Configuring Tailscale auth key..." sed -i "s/your_tailscale_auth_key_here/${TAILSCALE_AUTH_KEY}/" .env fi
# Set invite-only mode if enabled if [ "${INVITE_ONLY}" = "true" ]; then echo "🔒 Enabling invite-only mode..." echo "INVITE_ONLY=true" >> .env fi
# Add Tenor API key if provided if [ -n "${TENOR_API_KEY}" ]; then echo "🎞️ Adding Tenor API key..." echo "TENOR_API_KEY=${TENOR_API_KEY}" >> .env fi
echo "===================================" echo "✅ STOAT CHAT - SETUP COMPLETE" echo "===================================" echo "" echo "📋 NEXT STEPS:" if [ "${DEPLOYMENT_MODE}" = "tailscale" ]; then echo "1. Make sure Tailscale is set up on your network" echo "2. Start the containers: docker compose up -d" echo "3. Run: ./tailscale-setup.sh to configure Tailscale Serve" echo "4. Access Stoat at: https://${TAILSCALE_HOSTNAME}.your-tailnet.ts.net" else echo "1. Make sure your domain DNS points to this server" echo "2. Start the containers: docker compose up -d" echo "3. Access Stoat at: https://${STOAT_DOMAIN}" fi echo "" echo "📖 Full documentation: https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/stoat-unraid" echo "🆘 Support: https://github.com/revoltchat/self-hosted/issues" echo ""
